title: Example vNext execution graph
objective: Complete the vNext refactor as one coherent architecture without breaking protected contracts.
architecture_decisions: The domain service remains the durable state owner.
The web layer consumes the domain contract and does not duplicate ownership.
protected_contracts: Existing public API routes remain compatible unless an explicit migration task retires them.
Exact-head CI and independent review remain required before acceptance.
non_goals: Do not restore retired compatibility models.
Do not combine unrelated cleanup into implementation tasks.
acceptance_criteria: All graph tasks are accepted on their exact reviewed heads.
Repository-wide required checks pass after integration.

tasks.title: Stabilize the shared domain contract
tasks.goal: Establish the shared contract that downstream services must consume.
tasks.why_now: Downstream work would otherwise optimize against an unstable boundary.
scope: Shared domain contract and its canonical adapter.
protected_contracts: There is exactly one durable owner for the shared domain state.
implementation_steps: Characterize the current contract with focused tests.
Implement the smallest coherent migration to the target boundary.
Remove only duplicate ownership made obsolete by the migration.
integration_notes: DOMAIN-1002 consumes this contract and must not duplicate it.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate domain owner remains in the changed scope.

tasks.title: Migrate the downstream planner
tasks.goal: Move the planner onto the stabilized shared contract.
tasks.why_now: The shared contract must be accepted before planner migration can be safe.
protected_contracts: Planner does not become a second durable state owner.
implementation_steps: Switch planner reads/writes to the shared contract.
Delete planner-local compatibility code only after parity tests pass.
integration_notes: Keep notification integration untouched unless required by the shared contract.
acceptance_criteria: Planner focused tests pass against the new contract.
No retired compatibility path is reachable.
